entries.purpose: test-only conformance fixture (M8 slice 6): measures the project-shape pipeline against this repository's own tracked tree at one fixed Git revision; serves no surface
entries.contractVersionSource: accepted RFC-0004/general-contract.md as amended by the 2026-09-01 general trusted-bootstrap transaction (CONTRACT-AMENDMENT-MANIFEST.txt row)

governingBehaviorContract.signedBy: the PWB behavior acts in force when this entry is acted on; this value is regenerated after every PWB specification act that lands first

entries.authorizationModeDerivation: every artifact must have a current exact digest-bound owner act; independently-verified only when all three acts verify through A1; owner-trusted-bootstrap when at least one valid act remains owner-adopted bootstrap and the others are valid state-(1) or state-(2) acts; every other combination rejects before body reads
entries.provenanceDisclosure: Observation uses owner-trusted records; independent audit is not configured.
entries.implementation: none yet; a conformance module under packages/three-surface-poc-core/src/ would be added by M8 slice 6 only after all three self-observation acts exist
entries.implementationStatus: no implementation reads this entry; adopting it authorizes no code change by itself

surfaceExposure.rule: the page and machine answer are built only as in-memory values inside the conformance test process and are never served, cached, logged or written anywhere

entries.determinism: same exact inputs produce byte-equivalent deterministic facts

typedAuthority.readAuthority: within this repository's own Git object database at the one fixed revision the conformance fixture names, phase A reads only the root index the secret-classification policy's self-observation scope names, the further indexes this profile declares, and Git tree metadata needed to derive the manifest; phase B reads only normalized repository-relative paths addressed as exact Git objects in that revision-bound manifest

observationGrammar.profileNote: this repository declares no catalog, no root summary and no precedence table in the grammar this observer reads, so this profile declares none; every catalog-count, root-summary and precedence-dependent claim is Unknown rather than borrowed from another profile

resourceLimitSemantics.maxSources: the complete revision-bound manifest; an excess preserves every tree-known source identity but admits no source body and makes every dependent fact Unknown
resourceLimitSemantics.maxBytesPerSource: the exact UTF-8 blob before classification or parsing; the limit plus one byte is never passed to an extractor
resourceLimitSemantics.maxTotalBytes: one cumulative counter across phase A and phase B; count each repository-relative-path plus object-id body once and never reset between phases
resourceLimitSemantics.maxParsePassesPerSource: one unit is one complete traversal of one decoded source by a pass in parsePassIdentities; a helper traversal is charged to its named caller pass, repeating a pass counts again, and an unregistered traversal is forbidden; elapsed wall-clock time is not an input
resourceLimitSemantics.maxHumanResponseBytes: the final encoded body of each Polaris HTML page the conformance test renders in memory; this entry serves no HTTP response
resourceLimitSemantics.maxMachineResponseBytes: the final encoded body of each Polaris machine JSON answer the conformance test renders in memory; this entry serves no HTTP response
resourceLimitSemantics.breachResult: source and input breaches retain the complete population and make dependent facts Unknown; final-output breaches emit only a bounded typed failure carrying evaluation identity, limit identity, declared value, observed value and population counts; no truncated or success-shaped model is emitted; PWB-REQ-021 readiness is false
